title: Russian Grape Tomatoes Pilaf
description: A nutty and fluffy post-workout dish featuring grape tomatoes and beurre-monte, made with ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients. This recipe is perfect for a healthy and satisfying lunch.
instructions: Rinse the brown rice in a fine mesh strainer and drain well.
In a medium saucepan, bring 2 cups of water to a boil.
Add the brown rice to the saucepan, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, heat the ghee in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the halved grape tomatoes to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the beurre-monte and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Fluff the cooked brown rice with a fork and stir in the chopped parsley and dill.
Season the rice with salt and black pepper to taste.
Combine the cooked rice with the grape tomato mixture and serve hot.
